name: checkpoint-diff-is-a-read
description: `checkpoint diff` only ever means 'show me'. Under the old `undo` surface the destructive action was the *default* branch, so any flag combination the parser failed to recognise fell through to restoring the project; the verb is what removes that hazard, and this pins it — no 'Reverted' line, exit 0, nothing touched. With nothing snapshotted it says so rather than erroring
